brightport_emyro.m: Human again? Why come here, not welcome. Leave.
r: I mean no harm. Bryma said your kind's been troubling her, so I came to find out why.
I was just out for a stroll, and you bolted like your tail was on fire. Thought I'd see what all the fuss was about

brightport_emyro_0.m: The creature steps back cautiously, its claws scraping the stone floor.

brightport_emyrocave2.m: Bryma, that name stinks of lies! You call us trouble, but never ask why? Always blaming, never listen.

brightport_emyrocave3.m: She took what's not hers. Bones of our elders, sacred to us! We try to recover them, but she sends beasts. You call us trouble? She's the trouble!
r: I didn't know that. Maybe I could help you?
I've had enough of your rambling. [Attack the creature.]

brightport_emyrocave4.m: You! You smell of the witch. The witch who brought trouble!

brightport_emyrocave5.m: No! But I am only Emyro, the scout. Our leader must decide. Find our home, and leader Elyzard will tell...

brightport_emyrocave6.m: The lizard cautiously steps back, then leaps out the entrance of the burial cave.

brightport_emyrofight.m: As you attempt to attack the creature it swiftly tries to evade your blow, but your combat experience allows you to land a grazing strike. However, the spot it moved to to avoid your attack puts it close to the entrance, allowing it to nimbly leap into the cave opening.

brightport_lizard1.m: The mysterious creature leaps over the rubble to the other side of the cave.

brightport_lizard.1: In the rundown mysterious basement behind Bryma's house, I encountered a humanoid green creature that fled beyond a pile of cave rubble.
brightport_lizard.5: When I questioned Bryma about the creature, she explained that lizardmen live in the caves beneath her house and have been bothering her for some time.
brightport_lizard.10: I agreed to help Bryma with her problem. She shared the activation phrase for another statue leading deeper into the forest.
brightport_lizard.15: After navigating through the caves, I reached an open chamber beyond the rubble, where I found the lizardman again.
brightport_lizard.20: The lizardman regarded me suspiciously, calling me an intruder. He claimed Bryma had been stealing bones from their ancestral tomb, which his people were trying to recover.
brightport_lizard.25: I attacked the lizardman, but my attack merely grazed it, before it fled deeper into the caves.
brightport_lizard.30: I tried to calm Emyro's worries. He hesitated but told me to visit their leader before disappearing into the shadows.
brightport_lizard.32: I tracked down and killed the lizardmen's leader, Elyzard.
brightport_lizard.35: I killed the rest of those slimy lizards. Bryma can now rest free.
brightport_lizard.36: I received a reward from Bryma for getting rid of the creatures.
brightport_lizard.40: To earn the trust of the tribe's leader, Elyzard. I swore to return the 13 stolen bones.
brightport_lizard.50: To my astonishment, I discovered that Bryma had ground the bones into dust for her research and fertilizer experiments.
brightport_lizard.55: Bryma suggested I retrieve replacement bones from other sources. She advised hunting the hostile red lizardmen in the nearby area until I could gather the required amount.
brightport_lizard.60: I delivered the bones to Elyzard, who acknowledged my effort but requested one more task. He instructed me to visit the Shadow Chaplain's cave for further guidance.
brightport_lizard.65: From Dominio, the Shadow chaplain, I learned that beasts of darkness were attacking the tribe from an ancient ruin on the western side of the cave.
brightport_lizard.70: To stop the attacks, I was tasked with destroying two crystals within the ruins by chanting the phrase "Kazaul thu'um kha'zan" before striking them.
brightport_lizard.90: Elyzard recognized my effort, and rewarded me with a trinbal artifact.
brightport_lizard.95: I offered the lizardmen a deal of cooperation to supply Bryma with animal bones as a sign of mutual respect.
brightport_lizard.100: Bryma agreed to stop intruding on the lizardmen's tomb, as they promised to supply her with bones for her research.
brightport_lizard.110: Bryma agreed to stop intruding on the lizardmen's tomb.
